Final categorization: EXCLUDED  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on LULC prediction, but it fails the core inclusion criterion of explicit national-scale spatial implementation. The study area is Prayagraj district in Uttar Pradesh, India—a sub-national, regional administrative unit. All analysis, modeling, and projections are conducted at the district level (~5,482 km²), not at the national (country-wide) scale. Although the paper implements LULC prediction using MLP-Markov chain, includes future scenarios (2035, 2050), reports quantitative accuracy metrics (>89% classification accuracy, kappa statistics), and produces mapped projections, it does not meet the required national-scale scope. It also does not fall under 'REVIEW' since it presents original research. Therefore, it is excluded based on scale.)
